# TabloStyle Galleri (Tablo Style Gallery)

TabloStyle Galleri is an Azerbaijani online wall art, canvas, and velvet (məxmər) painting gallery and printing store based in Baku.

## Website

https://www.tablo-style.shop/

## Purpose

The website offers 202+ curated wall art designs (codes TS-GAL-001 to TS-GAL-202), custom photo canvas printing, transparent AZN pricing, interior design guides, and gift ideas across Azerbaijan.

## Pricing Summary (AZN)

- Canvas (Kanvas): 15 AZN (45x30 cm, 40x40 cm), 25 AZN (45x75 cm, 50x70 cm), 50 AZN (70x100 cm), 100 AZN (100x150 cm)
- Thick Canvas (Kanvas Qalın 60x180 cm): 100 AZN
- 3-Piece Canvas (Kanvas 3-lü 45x75 cm): 70 AZN
- Velvet (Məxmər): 40 AZN (45x30 cm, 40x40 cm), 70 AZN (45x75 cm, 50x70 cm), 120 AZN (70x100 cm), 200 AZN (100x150 cm)

## Ordering & Delivery

- WhatsApp Order: +905540183188
- Delivery across Azerbaijan: Baku, Sumgayit, Ganja, Sheki, Lankaran, Mingachevir, Nakhchivan.
